scope: Two explicitly declared base-order page consumers in one read-only fixed-snapshot workflow; no cross-request cache or new index selection

selector.fit: nonnegative least squares, no intercept; enumerate all 16 active feature subsets; training labels are five-call median milliseconds for calibration seed only
selector.online: check eligibility and budget, collect EXPLAIN FORMAT JSON estimates for all eligible alternatives, score frozen model, execute one plan
selector.calibration_policy: model is frozen before reading evaluation measurements; no tuning or refitting from evaluation results
selector.scope_limit: selection among manually specified templates, not automatic source recovery or generalization to unseen workload shapes

memory.budgeted: shallow size of cache control object plus its primitive long[]; measured with Java Instrumentation; no other objects owned by cache
memory.capacity: at most pageA.limit + pageB.limit entries; two longs per entry (key,count)
memory.excluded: caller-owned flow token, request/output objects, JDBC buffers, total process heap/RSS, database work_mem
memory.lifetime: one workflow invocation, cleared and detached in finally; same-snapshot transaction may outlive it
memory.insufficient_budget: fallback before allocation/business execution; never truncate required outputs

includes: SQL construction and all business calls
both complete typed ordered results and serialization
online EXPLAIN and model scoring for selector
excludes: offline calibration and fitting, reported separately
production source analysis/live ORM binding, which are not implemented

semantic_cases: three fixtures times four page pairs; plus context mismatch, below/exact budget, closed/cross-flow cache, across-flow permission change and insufficient shared-domain mutant
fairness: All plans know both consumers in advance and use the same indexes, snapshot, data and client-cache budget; database sharing is an explicit strong baseline; repeated timings start with no retained application cache
stop: One calibration/evaluation sequence; preserve failures; no result-driven extra cases, indexes, parameter tuning, or additional consumers
